_comment: Claude Code MCP configuration for DeviceHands, in the project-scope format (.mcp.json at a project root). Easiest is to let Claude Code write it: claude mcp add devicehands -- uv run --project /path/to/devicehands dhands-mcp (add -s project for .mcp.json, -s user for every directory). Replace /path/to/devicehands with your actual clone path.

_notes.DHANDS_WORKSPACE: Where collected logs/bugreports/anr land. Default <data dir>/workspace if unset (see docs/configuration.md).
_notes.DHANDS_LOG_LEVEL: debug | info | warning | error. For troubleshooting set to debug.
_notes.first_run: On first invocation, run: dhands setup adb (or ssh / serial / wifi) interactively once. After that the MCP server can be started by Claude Code.
_notes.multiple_instances: If you want multiple configs (e.g. lab and dev), register them with different names: 'dhands-lab', 'dhands-dev', each pointing to its own DHANDS_PROFILE.
